_meta.purpose: HOME-BASED BUSINESS validity set (n=50). The actual lead-magnet population: thin public evidence, sole operators, statutory scale caps. Tests the 0.9.0 display_floor change on the population where evidence coverage is genuinely lowest.
_meta.LABEL_SOURCE: PRESS-DOCUMENTED GRADUATION: pandemic-era home-based business selling whole cakes and macarons from her kitchen; grew a loyal online following; opened a brick-and-mortar bakery at Millage, Eunos in late October. Name blends 'sandwich' and 'chio' (pretty), a reference to macarons.

form.category: Custom celebration cakes and bakes, ordered ahead for an occasion
form.positioning_sentence: Macarons and whole cakes with illustrated cards and packaging designed in-house.
form.differentiator: Macarons and whole cakes with illustrated cards and packaging designed in-house. Our graphics are drawn by the founder, an NTU animation graduate, so every order is built around the joy of gifting.
form.undercut_on: We were a home kitchen with no shopfront, so customers had to trust us on Instagram before ordering.
form.your_price_point: rolls S$14-16, whole cakes S$65, macarons S$9-14
form.their_price_point: See the derived competitive set for the category ladder.

tier_0_default.why: Cheaper and instant. Many occasions resolve here.

tier_1_cheap_substitute.why: Same product much cheaper, walk-in, no lead time.

tier_2_direct_set.why: Same product, same occasion, same order-ahead model. The direct set is BOTH other home bakers and the commercial custom shops.

members: top home bakers with waitlists and sell-out drops
tier_3_category_incumbent.why: Each holds a rung: 'the one everyone knows', 'the safe mass choice', 'the one that does the weird thing'.

tier_4_adjacent_crossover.why: Takes the same celebration moment with a different product.

tier_7_new_entrants.why: Derived from the home-baker directories and new Instagram accounts, not asked of the owner.
